english.title: Cab driver fail possess / produce copy of cab-licence to police constable, examiner or court officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a cab-driver, failed to

(A)_[have a copy of your cab-driver's licence in your possession at all times during your employment as such]_
(B)_[have a copy of your cab-driver's licence in your possession at all times when appearing before a court, namely **(..SPECIFY COURT..)]_
(C)_[produce a copy of your cab-driver's licence for inspection on demand by a police constable, namely **(..SPECIFY CONSTABLE..)]_
(D)_[produce a copy of your cab-driver's licence for inspection on demand by a Public Carriage Examiner, namely **(..SPECIFY EXAMINER..)]_
(E)_[produce a copy of your cab-driver's licence for inspection on demand by an officer of the **(..SPECIFY COURT..), namely **(..SPECIFY EXAMINER..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to article 28 of the London Cab Order 1934 and section 10 of the Metropolitan Carriage Act 1869.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
not possessing copy of his/her cab-driver's licence
during employment as a cab-driver OR when appearing before a court
OR fail produce it for inspection on demand by police constable or Public Carriage Examiner or court officer
